# Lackadaisical Perfection – David Rivera

> Original neo-classical piano by composer David Rivera. Free, printable piano sheet music with chords (PDF, no sign-up): every piece comes as a piano solo and a chord edition with chord symbols above the staff. For fans of Ludovico Einaudi, Yiruma and Joep Beving. Terms: free for personal use, teaching and performance. Please don't resell or redistribute.

## Free sheet music
- [Scores page](https://lackadaisicalperfection.com/scores/): all free scores, with key, level, tempo, time signature and length for each piece, plus an FAQ.
- [Tapestry of Whispers – piano solo (PDF)](https://lackadaisicalperfection.com/assets/tapestry-of-whispers-score.pdf): E minor, 4/4, 115 BPM, 2:28, early intermediate (approx. RCM 3–4 / ABRSM 2–3), 3 pages. Sweet, playful, with a light dance feel.
- [Tapestry of Whispers – with chords (PDF)](https://lackadaisicalperfection.com/assets/tapestry-of-whispers-chords.pdf): the same score with chord symbols, 3 pages.
- [Obsession – piano solo (PDF)](https://lackadaisicalperfection.com/assets/obsession-score.pdf): G minor (the recorded key), 4/4, Allegro with expression 152 BPM, 3:27, early intermediate, 5 pages. Driven and mesmerizing.
- [Obsession – with chords, G minor (PDF)](https://lackadaisicalperfection.com/assets/obsession-chords-g-minor.pdf): 5 pages.
- [Obsession – with chords, transposed to A minor (PDF)](https://lackadaisicalperfection.com/assets/obsession-chords-a-minor.pdf): transposed chord edition, 6 pages.
- [Halcyon – piano solo (PDF)](https://lackadaisicalperfection.com/assets/halcyon-score.pdf): D minor, 4/4, Andante 106 BPM, 3:14, early intermediate, 4 pages. Unhurried yet driven: steady momentum without rushing, held with restraint.
- [Halcyon – with chords (PDF)](https://lackadaisicalperfection.com/assets/halcyon-chords.pdf): 4 pages.
- [Song of the Grasshopper, with chords (PDF)](https://lackadaisicalperfection.com/assets/song-of-the-grasshopper-chords.pdf): B minor (the recording is in A sharp minor), 4/4, 142 BPM, 3:11, 5 pages. From the album Piano Reveries and Phantasies.
- Luminescent Dreams: a largo waltz in A minor, 3/4, 4:38, intermediate (approx. RCM 5–6 / ABRSM 4–5). Preview page on the Scores page now; the free piano solo and chord edition arrive on 6 November 2026.
